Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition BeModelScoreResult

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
BeModelScoreResult 0..*BaseBeScoreResult model
Instances of this type can be the target of a Reference
BeModelScoreResult.identifier 1..*IdentifierIdentifier of this administration of the assessment scale
BeModelScoreResult.patient 1..1Reference()The patient the assessment scale is taken for
BeModelScoreResult.evaluator 0..*Reference()Care professional or organization responsible for taking the standardised assessment scale
BeModelScoreResult.recorder 1..1Reference()The person or system that records the assessment in the record - the same care provider, another collaborator, or the software itself when recording is automatic
BeModelScoreResult.recordedDate 1..1dateTimeDate the standardised assessment scale was finally encoded in the system
BeModelScoreResult.observationDate 1..1dateTimeEnd date of the observation and/or reference period for all information collected during the assessment
BeModelScoreResult.hasMember 0..*Reference()Groups the separate observations that make up this assessment
BeModelScoreResult.category 0..*CodeableConceptThe category of the medical assessment
BeModelScoreResult.code 1..1CodeableConceptIdentifies the assessment scale, for example SNOMED 273547007 Katz activities of daily living (assessment scale)
BeModelScoreResult.minMax 0..1RangeThe possible score range of the scale, for example 0-12
BeModelScoreResult.value[x] 0..1The score of the scale, as a number with a unit or as a coded clinical finding
BeModelScoreResult.value[x].valueQuantityQuantity
BeModelScoreResult.value[x].valueCodeableConceptCodeableConcept
BeModelScoreResult.status 1..1codeStatus of the observation
BeModelScoreResult.method 0..1CodeableConceptHow the observation was obtained
BeModelScoreResult.codeDisplay 0..*stringThe description corresponding to the value of the score
BeModelScoreResult.interpretation 0..*CodeableConceptThe conclusion drawn from the total score
BeModelScoreResult.component 0..*BaseA sub-score or component of the assessment scale
BeModelScoreResult.component.code 0..*CodeableConceptIdentifies the sub-score or component of the assessment scale, for example a sub-scale within a standardised scale
BeModelScoreResult.component.value[x] 0..1The numeric value or score for this component
BeModelScoreResult.component.value[x].valueQuantityQuantity
BeModelScoreResult.component.value[x].valueCodeableConceptCodeableConcept
BeModelScoreResult.component.interpretation 0..*CodeableConceptThe clinical interpretation of the sub-score, as text or coded
BeModelScoreResult.note 0..*AnnotationFree text field
